desc:
⚡ Welcome to +1 Speedster Parkour Obby Escape

How to play:
- Gain Speed by progressing through stages
- Beat all the stages using your flash abilities
- Unlock upgrades to increase speed
- Rebirth to reset and become stronger each run
- Use AFK training to earn while idle

Controls:
E : Dash
V : Phase
Jump on Wall : Wallrun
Spacebar x2 : Double Jump

🏆 Train your flash, master movement, and escape faster every run!

Join the community to unlock FREE gift in-game!
